name.description: Tool name; must equal the catalog directory name

type.description: Installation class: plain archive, single binary, or full runtime distribution

artifact.description: Artifact file name template; only {version} is substituted — each platform spells out its own full name, nothing is inferred from os/arch. Must be a plain file name: no path separators or shell metacharacters

items.description: Relative path inside the install directory; never absolute, never containing '..'

env.description: Extra env vars for BackendExecEnv; {install_path}/{version} substituted

oneOf.title: tool built with go install from a go-proxy module

name.description: Tool name; must equal the catalog directory name AND the last path element of module (go install names the binary after it)

type.description: Installed by running 'go install <module>@v<version>' against the plugin-controlled GOPROXY

module.description: Full package path passed to 'go install'. Lowercase only (uppercase module paths would need go-proxy escaping, which is not implemented, so they are refused), host-looking first segment (contains a dot), at least one slash, no '..', and no path segment starting or ending with a dot (go refuses those)

module_root.description: Module root used for 'go mod download' when a version carries an h1 checksum. Must be a prefix of module. Optional: when absent, module itself is treated as the module root

env.description: Extra env vars for BackendExecEnv; {install_path}/{version} substituted

oneOf.title: package installed via the npm ecosystem's package manager

name.description: Tool name; must equal the catalog directory name

type.description: Installed by running 'npm install -g' (or the runner selected by MISE_VAULT_NPM_RUNNER) against the user's own npm registry configuration; the toolchain and its network path are the user's responsibility, not the plugin's

package.description: npm package name, optionally scoped (@scope/name); the / is the only path separator allowed anywhere in the value. Lowercase only and narrower than npm's own rules: a shell-safety envelope, not a full syntax validator — a value can match here and still not exist in the registry

bin.description: Executable name the plugin verifies exists after install and exposes on PATH; defaults to the tool name when absent. An expectation, not an instruction: the installer decides what it writes, the plugin never renames anything

env.description: Extra env vars for BackendExecEnv; {install_path}/{version} substituted

oneOf.title: package installed via the PyPI ecosystem's package manager

name.description: Tool name; must equal the catalog directory name

type.description: Installed by running 'pipx install' (default) or 'uv tool install' (MISE_VAULT_PYPI_RUNNER=uv) against the user's own PyPI index configuration; the toolchain and its network path are the user's responsibility, not the plugin's

package.description: PEP 503 normalized PyPI package name. The catalog stores only the normalized form; scripts/add-version refuses a non-normalized input and names the normalized form to use, instead of silently rewriting it

bin.description: Executable name the plugin verifies exists after install and exposes on PATH; defaults to the tool name when absent (a PyPI project's console-script name may differ from its project name, e.g. httpie installs http)

env.description: Extra env vars for BackendExecEnv; {install_path}/{version} substituted
